title: I Posted the Office Microwave Timer Logs After the Fish Hearing

parts.text: They held a fifteen-minute "culture huddle" about the microwave smelling like fish and looked at me. I eat lentil soup. I was twenty-eight. The microwave history on the smart display showed 12:41, salmon, 4 minutes, user G.HAYES. Glenn from sales. I photographed the display before they wiped it. Glenn said smart displays glitch. HR asked us to be adults. Then Glenn microwaved salmon again at 12:44 while the huddle was still standing in the kitchen.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: He hit start on the salmon while HR was still telling us to be adults.

social.video_title: They blamed my lentils for his salmon button — Part 1/2
social.description: Culture huddle, smart display, G.HAYES at 12:41. Then 12:44. Would you have photographed the screen?

parts.text: I dropped the two timestamps in the huddle Slack with the photo. Glenn said I was surveilling lunch. The display is a clock that tattles; I just read. HR asked him to use the street-level microwave. He did. The kitchen smelled like plastic and progress. My lentils continued. The smart display stayed. Adults, it turns out, can read a name.

social.video_title: The huddle Slack got both salmon times — Part 2/2
social.description: Street-level microwave, lentils redeemed, plastic air. Was a glitch a user ID?
